option.DisplayText: {{giant|Gigantism Plus}}: Verbosity of debug entries output to Player.log
option.helptext:
{{g|0}}: Only infrequnet entries will be sent to Player.log, and only for reporting on normal function. {{W|1}}: Debug entries will be sent to Player.log when certain functions are perfomed within this mod. {{o|2}}: More frequent Player.log entries for a wider array of functions, often tracing broad program flow. {{r|3}}: Even more Player.log entries including current internal values as they're passed around. {{R|4}}: {{R|Not Recommended}} | Maximum number of entries to Player.log including tracing common or frequent loops.
The value default is {{g|0}}.

option.DisplayText: {{giant|Gigantism Plus}}: Also show debug entries in the Message Queue
option.helptext:
When enabled, debug entries will be sent to the Message Queue any time (with few exceptions) they would be sent to Player.log. At higher levels of verbosity, this can be {{r|very}} "loud" and spammy.
The default is {{w|Disabled}}.

option.DisplayText: {{giant|Gigantism Plus}}: Show {{gigantic|Gigantism}} internal debug information in relevant ShortDescriptions displayed in the [{{W|l}}]ook UI.
option.helptext:
When enabled, internal debug information relating to the {{gigantic|Gigantism}} part will be displayed when [{{W|l}}]ooking at anything with the relevant parts.
The default is {{w|Disabled}}.

option.DisplayText: {{giant|Gigantism Plus}}: Show {{yuge|Stew Belly}} internal debug information in relevant ShortDescriptions displayed in the [{{W|l}}]ook UI.
option.helptext:
When enabled, internal debug information relating to the {{yuge|Stew Belly}} part will be displayed when [{{W|l}}]ooking at anything with the relevant parts.
The default is {{w|Disabled}}.

option.DisplayText: {{giant|Gigantism Plus}}: Show WrassleID internal debug information in relevant ShortDescriptions displayed in the [{{W|l}}]ook UI.
option.helptext:
When enabled, internal debug information relating to the WrassleID part will be displayed when [{{W|l}}]ooking at anything with the relevant parts.
{{M|WrassleID}}: {{W|Colors}}: Information relating to the WrassleID's associated colors.
The default is {{w|Disabled}}.

option.DisplayText: {{giant|Gigantism Plus}}: Show Tactics_Vault internal debug information in relevant ShortDescriptions displayed in the [{{W|l}}]ook UI.
option.helptext:
When enabled, internal debug information relating to the Tactics_Vault skill will be displayed when [{{W|l}}]ooking at anything with the relevant parts.
{{M|Vaulter}}: {{W|Cells and Vault State}}: Information relating to the cells involved in a current vault and which stage of vaulting the vaulter is up to. {{W|AutoAct State}}: Information relating to the Vault toggle ability and the info it uses to restart AutoAct. {{M|Vaultable}}: {{W|Nav Weight}}: Explicit navigation weight numbers. {{W|Vaultable Cells}}: Visualisation of which cells are eligble for being vaulted from/into.
The default is {{w|Disabled}}.

option.DisplayText: Use colorful text strings throughout the mod
option.helptext:
This mod makes use of a number of custom {{giant|colors}} and {{gianter|shaders}} in a lot of places vanilla does, but also in a number of places vanilla doesn't. To give you the ability to maintain the vanilla aesthetic, this slider should adjust which colors appear where.
{{Z|3}}: {{gigantic|Gigantic}} shaders (or their {{w|Fallbacks}} if they fail to load) all throughout the mod. {{w|2}}: {{w|Fallback}} shaders all throughout the mod. {{Y|1}}: Regular, plain text with some infrequent use of {{w|Fallback}} where it matches vanilla.
The default is {{Z|3}}.

A {{gigantic|gigantic}} character would have {{gigantic|gigantic}} equipment when they arrive in Qud. Disabling this option will make for a more difficult start.
The default is {{W|Enabled}}.

The {{gigantic|gigantic}} modifier typically increases the radius of grenades which could represent a significant reduction in starting difficulty for characters who generate with several of them.
The default is {{w|Disabled}}.

({{r|D}})efects aren't typically able to be leveled up and are excluded from rapid advancement by default. When enabled, {{gigantism|Gigantism}} ({{r|D}}) will be included in the list of physical mutations for this purpose.
The default is {{W|Enabled}}.

This makes the {{gigantic|gigantic}} modifier tinkerable, including the availability of the data disk for it. Its tech tier has been adjusted up to 3 so that it will cost at least a {{b|3}} bit to tinker. Tinker I is the required skill.
The default is {{W|Enabled}}.

This makes {{gigantic|gigantic}} items a little less rare to find by adjusting their rarity from R2 to R. Some examples of other mods with R rarity: {{spiked|Spiked}}, {{k|Nulling}}, and {{C|Radio Powered}}.
The default is {{W|Enabled}}.

Should equipment carried by {{gigantic|gigantic}} NPCs be {{gigantic|gigantic}}? This option can be changed mid-game, however, due to targeting the creation of the creature, it will only apply to creatures generated after this option is enabled.
The default is {{W|Enabled}}.

Should grenades carried by {{gigantic|gigantic}} NPCs be {{gigantic|gigantic}}? {{gigantic|Gigantic}} grenades have a larger blast radius, which can make encounters significantly harder. This option can be changed mid-game, however, due to targeting the creation of the creature, it will only apply to creatures generated after this option is enabled.
The default is {{w|Disabled}}.

option.DisplayText: Override chance that player characters who start with {{gigantic|Gigantism}} ({{r|D}}) will start with Wrassle Equipment
option.helptext:
Creatures have a 15% chance, under most circumstances, to spawn with Wrassle Equipment if they spawn with {{gigantic|Gigantism}} ({{r|D}}). The player has a much smaller chance due to it being a full set of gear and a weapon. When enabled, this option presents a slider to manually select the chance that player characters will spawn with their own unique set.
The default is {{w|Disabled}}.

option.DisplayText: Chance in 1,000 that player characters with {{gigantic|Gigantism}} ({{r|D}}) will start with Wrassle Equipment
option.helptext:
This slider represents the chance in 1,000 that when a player character spawns with {{gigantic|Gigantism}} ({{r|D}}), they will start with a full set of their own personal unique Wrassle Equipment with randomly (seeded) selected tiles, colors, and shader.
Select 0 to disable this feature. Select 100 to have this occur 10% of the time. Select 1,000 to force this feature.
The default is {{c|1}}.

option.DisplayText: Enable "prerelease" content for this mod ({{R|new save}})
option.helptext:
This mod has a number of things in the works that are planned for future updates but which aren't quite ready yet.
With this option enabled, content that is unfinished, close to finished but unpolished, or in the process of being balanced will be available to test out with the understanding that it's not stable, and is liable to leave your run/save in a locked or broken state, often in "fun" and "exciting" ways we can't predict (if you find any of these interesting interactions, please let us know on the GitHub linked in the steam workshop for this mod, or on the steam workshop page itself).
This mod adds a number of wishes we're willing to share that might assist in fixing a save that has succumb to prerelease content jank and several of the base game wishes have helped us unbreak things as we test these out.
Playing with this option enabled requires a mind-set wherein you don't get as attached to your run as you normally would, and flexibility enough to accept using wishes to "unbork" things.
Non-exhaustive list of prerelease stuff: ù Wrassling system (very early) ù Vaultable game objects (low walls, etc.)
{{r|Your best bet is to begin a new run after changing this setting. Several of its parts occur during world generation.}}
The default is {{w|Disabled}}.
